meta.note: The calendar, completed. Batch 2 gave four months out of twelve and no seasons at all — a closed set taught half is worse than not taught, because you cannot tell which half you are missing.

cards.ex_t: O Carnaval é em fevereiro.
cards.ex_trans: Carnival is in February.

cards.note: 25 de Abril is the revolution and a public holiday
cards.ex_t: O 25 de Abril é feriado.
cards.ex_trans: The 25th of April is a public holiday.

cards.ex_t: Em maio a Madeira está cheia de flores.
cards.ex_trans: In May Madeira is full of flowers.

cards.note: the santos populares month, with street festivals everywhere
cards.ex_t: Em junho há festas nas ruas.
cards.ex_trans: In June there are street festivals.

cards.ex_t: Julho é o mês mais cheio de turistas.
cards.ex_trans: July is the month most full of tourists.

cards.ex_t: As aulas começam em setembro.
cards.ex_trans: Classes start in September.

cards.ex_t: Em outubro ainda dá para ir à praia.
cards.ex_trans: In October you can still go to the beach.

cards.ex_t: Novembro é o mês mais chuvoso.
cards.ex_trans: November is the rainiest month.

cards.note: seasons take the article: na primavera
cards.ex_t: Na primavera o tempo está agradável.
cards.ex_trans: In spring the weather is pleasant.

cards.ex_t: No verão a ilha fica cheia.
cards.ex_trans: In summer the island gets full.

cards.note: British autumn, not American fall — pt-PT learners read British English
cards.ex_t: No outono chove mais.
cards.ex_trans: In autumn it rains more.

cards.note: on Madeira it means rain and wind, rarely cold
cards.ex_t: O inverno na Madeira é suave.
cards.ex_trans: Winter in Madeira is mild.

cards.note: both meanings — estação do ano is the season, estação de comboios the station
cards.ex_t: Qual é a tua estação do ano preferida?
cards.ex_trans: Which is your favourite season?

cards.note: de manhã = in the morning; mind the nasal ã
cards.ex_t: De manhã bebo sempre um café.
cards.ex_trans: In the morning I always drink a coffee.

cards.ex_t: À tarde vou ao médico.
cards.ex_trans: In the afternoon I am going to the doctor.

cards.note: à noite = at night; ontem à noite = last night
cards.ex_t: Ontem à noite houve muito barulho.
cards.ex_trans: Last night there was a lot of noise.

cards.note: roughly midnight to dawn — a word with no tidy English equivalent
cards.ex_t: O voo chega de madrugada.
cards.ex_trans: The flight arrives in the small hours.

cards.ex_t: Anteontem estive no mercado.
cards.ex_trans: The day before yesterday I was at the market.

cards.ex_t: Depois de amanhã tenho consulta.
cards.ex_trans: The day after tomorrow I have an appointment.

cards.note: how people actually give an inexact time
cards.ex_t: Chego por volta das sete.
cards.ex_trans: I arrive around seven.

cards.ex_t: A reunião é às nove em ponto.
cards.ex_trans: The meeting is at nine sharp.
